4-UNITNING TO'RTINCHI BETI (29-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Days to Remember' va TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '4'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Past Continuous' sarlavhasi.
17) 'Study the sentences, then match the verbs in bold to their uses.' To'rtta gap (raqamli katakchalar bilan), ostida a - d qo'llanishlar.
• Och ko'k-yashil ramkali 'Form' qutisi: past continuous qanday yasalishi; Affirmative, Negative, Interrogative, Short Answers qatorlari bilan.
18) 'What were you doing at these times - last Monday? - last Sunday?' To'q sariq ramkada olti vaqt: 6 am, 11 am, 7 pm / 8:30 am, 3:30 pm, 10:30 pm. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'At 6 am last Monday I was getting dressed. At the same time last Sunday I was sleeping.'

O'NG USTUN:
19) 'These people were in the garden last Sunday at midday. Look at the pictures and correct the sentences.'
Ostida BESh SURATLI polosa (bog'da), har birida qo'lyozma yorliq:
• 'Paul' - qizil ko'ylakdagi erkak eshikni bo'yamoqda
• 'Ann' - gazon o'rish mashinasi bilan turgan odam
• 'Sue' - skameykada o'tirib olma yeyayotgan ayol
• 'Jane & Mary' - somon shlyapali ikki qiz gullarni sug'ormoqda
• 'Bob' - erkak arqonga kir yoymoqda
Ostida beshta gap; 1-gapga ko'k qiya javob berilgan (namuna).
• Och ko'k-yashil ramkali 'Beginnings - Endings' qutisi, ikki band bilan.
20) 'Put the verbs into the correct tense, then answer the questions.' Ikki qism: a) Laura haqidagi matn boshi (1-10 bo'shliq); b) matn oxiri (11-15 bo'shliq). Ostida oltita savol ikki ustunda.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Look at the pictures and the prompts in the Photo File section and write a beginning and an ending for the story. Use the extracts in Ex. 20 as a model.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '29'.

exercises.instructionEn: Form: We form the past continuous with was/were and the present participle of the main verb (verb + ing).
exercises.instructionUz: Yasalishi: Past continuous 'was/were' va asosiy fe'lning -ing shakli bilan yasaladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI.

  'We form the past continuous with
   WAS/WERE (past tense of the verb
   TO BE) and the PRESENT PARTICIPLE
   of the main verb (verb + ing).'


AFFIRMATIVE (tasdiq):
  I / he / she / it WAS eating
  we / you / they   WERE eating

NEGATIVE (inkor):
  I / he / she / it WASN'T eating
  we / you / they   WEREN'T eating

INTERROGATIVE (so'roq):
  WAS I / he / she / it eating?
  WERE we / you / they eating?

SHORT ANSWERS (qisqa javob):
  Yes, I / he / she / it WAS.
  No, he / she / it WASN'T.
  Yes, we / you / they WERE.
  No, we / you / they WEREN'T.


⚠ 'WAS' va 'WERE' - KIM BILAN:

  WAS  - I, he, she, it
  WERE - we, you, they

  ⚠ DIQQAT: 'I WAS' (hozirgi zamonda
  'I am' bo'lgani kabi), lekin
  'YOU WERE' (hatto bitta odam
  bo'lsa ham).


⚠ -ING QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:

  eat   → eating   (oddiy)
  make  → making   (oxirgi 'e' TUShADI)
  sit   → sitting  (qisqa unli + bitta
                    undosh → IKKILANADI)
  lie   → lying    (-ie → -ying)
  travel → travelling (Britaniyada 'l'
                    ikkilanadi)


⚠ 'A PRESENT PARTICIPLE':

  = -ing shakli.
  ⚠ 'present' bu yerda 'hozirgi zamon'
  emas - shunchaki shaklning nomi.
  ⚠ U past continuous da ham,
  present continuous da ham bir xil.


⚠ TO'RT QO'LLANISh (17-mashq):

  a) IKKI YoKI UNDAN KO'P ish BIR
     VAQTDA:
     'She WAS WEARING a dress and she
      WAS HOLDING flowers.'

  b) HIKOYaNING FONI:
     'It WAS RAINING heavily outside.'

  c) UZUN ishni QISQA ish BO'LDI:
     'She WAS WATCHING TV when the
      doorbell RANG.'

  d) O'TMIShNING ANIQ PAYTIDA davom
     etayotgan ish:
     'It was half past ten and Janice
      WAS WAITING for her husband.'


⚠ 'WHEN' va 'WHILE':

  WHEN + past simple (qisqa ish)
     'when the doorbell rang'
  WHILE + past continuous (uzun ish)
     'while she was watching TV'

  ⚠ Ikkalasi bir gapda:
  'WHILE she was watching TV, the
   doorbell rang.'
  = 'She was watching TV WHEN the
     doorbell rang.'


⚠ HOLAT FE'LLARI CONTINUOUSDA
BO'LMAYDI:

  know, understand, want, like, love,
  hate, need, believe, remember

  ⚠ 'I was knowing' - XATO.
  ⚠ 20-mashqda 'be' fe'li ham SIMPLE
  da qoladi: 'It WAS Christmas Eve.'

points.en: Affirmative: I/he/she/it was eating; we/you/they were eating
points.uz: Tasdiq: men/u yeyayotgan edim/edi; biz/siz/ular yeyayotgan edik/edingiz/edilar
points.noteUz:
⚠ WAS - I, he, she, it
⚠ WERE - we, you, they

⚠ 'YOU WERE' - hatto bitta odam bo'lsa ham.

points.en: Negative: I/he/she/it wasn't eating; we/you/they weren't eating
points.uz: Inkor: men/u yemayotgan edim/edi; biz/siz/ular yemayotgan edik

points.en: Interrogative: Was I/he/she/it eating? Were we/you/they eating?
points.uz: So'roq: Men/u yeyayotgan edimmi/edimi? Biz/siz/ular yeyayotgan edikmi?
points.noteUz:
⚠ SO'ROQDA 'was/were' EGADAN OLDIN turadi.
⚠ Qo'shimcha yordamchi fe'l KERAK EMAS
('did' XATO).

points.en: Short Answers: Yes, I was. / No, he wasn't. / Yes, they were. / No, we weren't.
points.uz: Qisqa javoblar: Ha, men edim. / Yo'q, u emas edi. / Ha, ular edilar. / Yo'q, biz emas edik.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.
⚠ Tasdiqda QISQARTMA IShLATILMAYDI:
"Yes, I was" ('Yes, I's' XATO).

points.en: -ing spelling: eat → eating, make → making, sit → sitting, lie → lying, travel → travelling
points.uz: -ing imlosi: eat → eating, make → making, sit → sitting, lie → lying, travel → travelling
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'E' tushadi; qisqa unli + bitta undosh →
undosh ikkilanadi; '-ie' → '-ying'.
⚠ Britaniyada 'travelLING' (ikki 'l').

exercises.instructionEn: Study the sentences, then match the verbs in bold to their uses.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'rganing, so'ng qalin harfli fe'llarni qo'llanishi bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT GAP - TO'RT QO'LLANISh.

  ⚠ Hamma gap 27-betdagi hikoyadan
  olingan.


QO'LLANIShLAR:

  a  two or more actions happening at
     the same time in the past
     = o'tmishda bir vaqtda bo'lgan
       ikki yoki undan ko'p ish

  b  background information in a story
     = hikoyaning foni

  c  action interrupted by another
     shorter action in the past
     = qisqaroq ish bo'lgan uzun ish

  d  action in progress at a stated
     time in the past
     = o'tmishning ANIQ paytida davom
       etayotgan ish


⚠ 'c' va 'd' FARQI:

  c - IKKI fe'l bor: uzun (continuous)
      va qisqa (simple).
      'She was watching TV WHEN the
       doorbell RANG.'

  d - BITTA fe'l bor, lekin ANIQ VAQT
      ko'rsatilgan.
      'It was HALF PAST TEN and Janice
       was waiting.'


⚠ 'b' - FON:

  Ob-havo, joy, atrof-muhit tasviri.
  ⚠ Hikoyalar ko'pincha shunday
  boshlanadi: 'It was raining ...',
  'The sun was shining ...'


⚠ 'a' - BIR VAQTDA:

  Odatda 'and' yoki 'while' bilan
  bog'lanadi:
  'She was wearing a dress AND she was
   holding flowers.'
  'WHILE I was cooking, he was reading.'


⚠ 'TO INTERRUPT':

  = bo'lmoq, to'xtatmoq.
  ⚠ 'an interruption' = uzilish.

pairs.left: 1  It was half past ten at night and Janice was waiting for her husband to come home.
pairs.right: d - action in progress at a stated time in the past
pairs.leftUz: Kechasi o'n yarim edi va Janice erining uyga qaytishini kutayotgan edi.
pairs.rightUz: d - o'tmishning aniq paytida davom etayotgan ish
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ ANIQ VAQT: 'half past ten at night'.
⚠ Bitta fe'l ('was waiting'), qisqa ish YO'Q.

pairs.left: 2  She was watching TV when the doorbell rang.
pairs.right: c - action interrupted by another shorter action in the past
pairs.leftUz: U televizor ko'rayotganda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.
pairs.rightUz: c - qisqaroq ish bo'lgan uzun ish
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ IKKI fe'l: 'was watching' (uzun) va 'rang'
(qisqa).
⚠ 'WHEN' + past simple - bo'luvchi ish.

pairs.left: 3  She was wearing a long white dress and she was holding a bouquet of flowers.
pairs.right: a - two or more actions happening at the same time in the past
pairs.leftUz: U uzun oq ko'ylak kiygan va guldasta ushlab turgan edi.
pairs.rightUz: a - o'tmishda bir vaqtda bo'lgan ikki ish
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ IKKI fe'l ham CONTINUOUS shaklda:
'was wearing' va 'was holding'.
⚠ 'and' bilan bog'langan - bir vaqtda.

pairs.right: b - background information in a story
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ OB-HAVO tasviri - hikoyaning FONI.
⚠ Hikoyalar ko'pincha shunday boshlanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: What were you doing at these times - last Monday? - last Sunday?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu vaqtlarda nima qilayotgan edingiz - o'tgan dushanba? - o'tgan yakshanba?
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI VAQT:

  6 am,    11 am,   7 pm
  8:30 am, 3:30 pm, 10:30 pm


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'At 6 am last Monday I WAS GETTING
   DRESSED.'
  'At the same time last Sunday I WAS
   SLEEPING.'


⚠ QOLIP:

  At [VAQT] last [KUN] I was [fe'l]-ing.
  At the same time last [KUN] I was
  [fe'l]-ing.


⚠ 'AT THE SAME TIME':

  = o'sha vaqtda.
  ⚠ Takrorlamaslik uchun juda qulay
  ibora.


⚠ 'TO GET DRESSED':

  = kiyinmoq.
  ⚠ 'get' + sifat = holat o'zgarishi:
     get dressed - kiyinmoq
     get ready - tayyorlanmoq
     get tired - charchamoq
     get married - turmush qurmoq


⚠ 'AM' va 'PM':

  am = tushgacha (ante meridiem)
  pm = tushdan keyin (post meridiem)

  ⚠ 12 am = yarim tun
  ⚠ 12 pm = tush payti
  ⚠ Bu ikkisi ko'p adashtiriladi.


⚠ FOYDALI FE'LLAR:

  getting up, getting dressed, having
  breakfast, going to school, having
  lessons, having lunch, coming home,
  doing homework, watching TV, having
  dinner, sleeping
exercises.exampleEn: At 6 am last Monday I was getting dressed. At the same time last Sunday I was sleeping.
exercises.exampleUz: O'tgan dushanba soat 6 da kiyinayotgan edim. O'tgan yakshanba o'sha vaqtda uxlayotgan edim.
modelAnswers: At 6 am last Monday I was getting dressed. At the same time last Sunday I was sleeping.
At 8:30 am last Monday I was going to school. At the same time last Sunday I was having breakfast.
At 11 am last Monday I was having a Maths lesson. At the same time last Sunday I was playing football.
At 3:30 pm last Monday I was coming home from school. At the same time last Sunday I was visiting my grandparents.
At 7 pm last Monday I was doing my homework. At the same time last Sunday I was watching TV.
At 10:30 pm last Monday I was sleeping. At the same time last Sunday I was reading a book.
modelAnswersUz: O'tgan dushanba soat 6 da kiyinayotgan edim. O'tgan yakshanba o'sha vaqtda uxlayotgan edim.
O'tgan dushanba 8:30 da maktabga ketayotgan edim. O'tgan yakshanba o'sha vaqtda nonushta qilayotgan edim.
O'tgan dushanba soat 11 da matematika darsida edim. O'tgan yakshanba o'sha vaqtda futbol o'ynayotgan edim.
O'tgan dushanba 15:30 da maktabdan qaytayotgan edim. O'tgan yakshanba o'sha vaqtda buvimnikiga borgan edim.
O'tgan dushanba soat 19 da uy vazifamni bajarayotgan edim. O'tgan yakshanba o'sha vaqtda televizor ko'rayotgan edim.
O'tgan dushanba 22:30 da uxlayotgan edim. O'tgan yakshanba o'sha vaqtda kitob o'qiyotgan edim.

exercises.instructionEn: These people were in the garden last Sunday at midday. Look at the pictures and correct the sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu odamlar o'tgan yakshanba tush paytida bog'da edi. Rasmlarga qarang va gaplarni to'g'rilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDAGI ODAMLAR VA IShLARI:

  Paul  - eshikni bo'yayapti
          (painting the door)
  Ann   - gazon o'ryapti
          (cutting the grass)
  Sue   - olma yeyapti
          (eating an apple)
  Jane & Mary - gullarni sug'oryapti
          (watering the flowers)
  Bob   - kir yoyapti
          (hanging out the washing)


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Paul was hanging out the washing.'
  → "Paul WASN'T hanging out the
     washing. He WAS PAINTING the door."

  ⚠ IKKI QADAM: avval INKOR, keyin
  TO'G'RI ma'lumot.


⚠ HAMMA GAP PAST CONTINUOUSDA:

  wasn't hanging / was painting
  wasn't eating / was cutting
  wasn't watering / was eating
  weren't cutting / were watering
  wasn't painting / was hanging out

  ⚠ 'Jane and Mary' - IKKI odam,
  shuning uchun 'WERE' va "WEREN'T".


⚠ 'AT MIDDAY':

  = tush payti (soat 12).
  ⚠ 'midday' = 'noon'.
  ⚠ Aksi: 'midnight' = yarim tun.


⚠ 'TO HANG OUT THE WASHING':

  = kir yoymoq (arqonga).
  ⚠ 'the washing' = yuvilgan kir
  (12-betdagi 1a mashqida
  'the washing-up' - IDISh yuvish edi;
  ADAShTIRMANG!).

  ⚠ 'to hang' - noto'g'ri fe'l:
  hang - hung - hung.


⚠ 'TO CUT THE GRASS':

  = gazon o'rmoq.
  ⚠ 'to mow the lawn' ham to'g'ri.
  ⚠ 'cut' - noto'g'ri fe'l: cut - cut -
  cut (o'zgarmaydi).


⚠ 'TO WATER':

  ⚠ 'water' - OT ham, FE'L ham:
  'to water the flowers' = gullarni
  sug'ormoq.
exercises.exampleEn: Paul was hanging out the washing. - Paul wasn't hanging out the washing. He was painting the door.
exercises.exampleUz: Pol kir yoyayotgan edi. - Pol kir yoymayotgan edi. U eshikni bo'yayotgan edi.
modelAnswers: Paul wasn't hanging out the washing. He was painting the door.
Ann wasn't eating an apple. She was cutting the grass.
Sue wasn't watering the flowers. She was eating an apple.
Jane and Mary weren't cutting the grass. They were watering the flowers.
Bob wasn't painting the door. He was hanging out the washing.
modelAnswersUz: Pol kir yoymayotgan edi. U eshikni bo'yayotgan edi.
Ann olma yemayotgan edi. U gazon o'rayotgan edi.
Sue gullarni sug'ormayotgan edi. U olma yeyayotgan edi.
Jeyn va Meri gazon o'rmayotgan edi. Ular gullarni sug'orayotgan edi.
Bob eshikni bo'yamayotgan edi. U kir yoyayotgan edi.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI.

  'At the BEGINNING of a story, we say
   WHERE and WHEN the story takes
   place, WHO the people are, and WHAT
   happened first.'

  'At the END of a story, we write WHAT
   HAPPENED IN THE END and HOW THE
   PEOPLE FELT.'


BOShLANIShDA TO'RT SAVOL:

  WHERE? - qayerda
  WHEN?  - qachon
  WHO?   - kim
  WHAT happened first? - avval nima
           bo'ldi

  ⚠ 20-mashqning 1-5 savollari aynan
  shu to'rt savolga tegishli.


TUGAShDA IKKI SAVOL:

  What happened in the end? - oxirida
     nima bo'ldi
  How did the people feel? - odamlar
     o'zini qanday his qildi

  ⚠ 20-mashqning 6-savoli aynan shu.


⚠ 27-BETDAGI HIKOYa ShU QOIDAGA
MOS KELADI:

  BOShLANIShI:
     WHEN: 'It was half past ten at
        night'
     WHERE: 'in the house'
     WHO: 'Janice ... her husband'
     WHAT FIRST: 'the doorbell rang'

  TUGAShI:
     WHAT IN THE END: 'that's her in the
        photograph'
     HOW FELT: 'gasped in amazement'


⚠ 'TO TAKE PLACE':

  = bo'lib o'tmoq, sodir bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 23-betdagi 29-mashqda ham bor edi.


⚠ 'IN THE END' va 'AT THE END':

  in the end = oxir-oqibat, natijada
  at the end (of sth) = ... ning
     oxirida

  ⚠ 'IN THE END he came.' = oxir-oqibat
  keldi.
  ⚠ 'AT THE END of the film ...' =
  filmning oxirida.

  ⚠ Qutida IKKALASI ham bor - farqni
  seziing.

points.en: At the beginning of a story, we say where and when the story takes place, who the people are, and what happened first.
points.uz: Hikoya boshida u qayerda va qachon bo'lganini, odamlar kimligini va avval nima sodir bo'lganini aytamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ TO'RT savol: WHERE? WHEN? WHO? WHAT FIRST?
⚠ 'to take place' = bo'lib o'tmoq.

points.en: At the end of a story, we write what happened in the end and how the people felt.
points.uz: Hikoya oxirida oxir-oqibat nima bo'lgani va odamlar o'zini qanday his qilganini yozamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs into the correct tense, then answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying, so'ng savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
LAURA HAQIDAGI HIKOYaNING BOShI VA
OXIRI.


⚠ QAYSI ZAMON QAYERDA:

  PAST CONTINUOUS - fon va uzun ish:
     1 was staring (fon)
     3 was travelling (fon)
     5 was wearing (tasvir)
     6 was carrying (tasvir)
     14 was waiting (fon)

  PAST SIMPLE - qisqa, ketma-ket ish:
     2 was ('be' - HOLAT fe'li!)
     4 entered
     7 sat
     8 opened
     9 took
     10 gave
     11 got
     12 put
     13 walked
     15 thought


⚠ 2-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  'It 2) ... (be) Christmas Eve.'
  → 'It WAS Christmas Eve.'

  ⚠ 'be' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS
  shaklda ISHLATILMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'It was being Christmas Eve' - XATO.


⚠ 4-BAND - 'SUDDENLY':

  'SUDDENLY an elderly gentleman
   4) ... (enter) her compartment.'
  → ENTERED

  ⚠ 'suddenly' = to'satdan - QISQA,
  kutilmagan ish belgisi → PAST SIMPLE.
  ⚠ Bu ish uzun 'was staring' ishini
  BO'LADI (17-mashqning 'c'
  qo'llanishi).


⚠ 7-10 BANDLAR - KETMA-KET IShLAR:

  sat → opened → took → gave

  ⚠ Hammasi PAST SIMPLE, chunki ular
  BIRIN-KETIN sodir bo'ladi.
  ⚠ Continuous bo'lsa, ular BIR VAQTDA
  bo'lgan bo'lardi - bu mantiqsiz.


⚠ NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:

  take → took
  give → gave
  get  → got
  put  → put (O'ZGARMAYDI)
  sit  → sat
  think → thought


⚠ 12-BAND - 'PUT':

  'carefully 12) ... (put) the envelope'
  → PUT

  ⚠ 'put' - o'tgan zamonda ham 'put'!
  ⚠ 'putted' - XATO.


⚠ 'CHRISTMAS EVE':

  = Rojdestvo arafasi (24-dekabr).
  ⚠ 'an eve' = arafa.
  ⚠ 'New Year's Eve' = Yangi yil arafasi.


⚠ 'A COMPARTMENT':

  = poyezd kupesi.


⚠ 'AN ENVELOPE':

  = konvert.
  ⚠ /ˈenvələʊp/ deb o'qiladi.

lines.speaker: a
lines.en: Laura 1) ___ (stare) through the train window at the cold, snowy fields.
lines.uz: Laura poyezd derazasidan sovuq, qorli dalalarga tikilib qarab turardi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ FON - hikoyaning boshlanishi → PAST
CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'to stare AT sth' = tikilib qaramoq.

lines.speaker: a
lines.en: It 2) ___ (be) Christmas Eve and she 3) ___ (travel) home from Newcastle to spend some time with her parents for the first time in months.
lines.uz: Rojdestvo arafasi edi va u oylar ichida birinchi marta ota-onasi bilan vaqt o'tkazish uchun Nyukasldan uyga ketayotgan edi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 2: 'be' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS BO'LMAYDI →
'WAS'.
⚠ 3: FON, uzun ish → 'was travelLING'
(Britaniyada ikki 'l').

lines.speaker: a
lines.en: Suddenly an elderly gentleman 4) ___ (enter) her compartment.
lines.uz: To'satdan bir keksa janob uning kupesiga kirdi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'SUDDENLY' - QISQA, kutilmagan ish belgisi →
PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ Bu ish uzun 'was staring' ishini BO'LADI
(17-mashqning 'c' qo'llanishi).
⚠ 'to enter' - PREDLOGSIZ.

lines.speaker: a
lines.en: He 5) ___ (wear) a black coat and he 6) ___ (carry) a briefcase.
lines.uz: U qora palto kiygan va portfel ko'targan edi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ TASVIR - ikki ish BIR VAQTDA → PAST
CONTINUOUS (17-mashqning 'a' qo'llanishi).
⚠ 'a briefcase' - 20-betda ham bor edi.

lines.speaker: a
lines.en: He 7) ___ (sit) opposite Laura, 8) ___ (open) his briefcase, 9) ___ (take) out an envelope and 10) ___ (give) it to Laura. ...
lines.uz: U Lauraning ro'parasiga o'tirdi, portfelini ochdi, konvert oldi va uni Lauraga uzatdi. ...
lines.whyUz:
⚠ To'rtta ish BIRIN-KETIN sodir bo'ladi →
hammasi PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ NOTO'G'RI fe'llar: sit→sat, take→took,
give→gave.
⚠ 'opposite' - PREDLOGSIZ.

lines.speaker: b
lines.en: ... Laura 11) ___ (get) off the train, carefully 12) ___ (put) the envelope in her bag and 13) ___ (walk) towards the car which 14) ___ (wait) for her.
lines.uz: ... Laura poyezddan tushdi, konvertni ehtiyotkorlik bilan sumkasiga soldi va uni kutayotgan mashina tomon yurdi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 11, 12, 13 - ketma-ket ishlar → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'put' - o'tgan zamonda ham 'PUT' ('putted' XATO).
⚠ 14 - mashina ALLAQAChON kutayotgan edi (fon) →
PAST CONTINUOUS.

lines.speaker: b
lines.uz: "Nima qilsam ekan?" - deb o'yladi u g'amgin holda.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'think' - HOLAT fe'li, bu yerda bir martalik
ish → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ NOTO'G'RI fe'l: think → thought.
⚠ 'sadly' - RAVISh ('sad' + -ly).

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SAVOL - 'BEGINNINGS - ENDINGS'
QUTISIDAGI SAVOLLAR.

  1-3  → hikoyaning BOShLANIShI
         (where, when)
  4-5  → kim va avval nima bo'ldi
  6    → hikoyaning TUGAShI

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu savollar - hikoya yozish
  uchun REJA.


⚠ SAVOLLARDA ZAMONGA DIQQAT:

  'Where WAS Laura?' - past simple
  'What WAS she DOING?' - past
     continuous
  'When DID the story TAKE PLACE?' -
     past simple
  'Who ARE the people involved?' -
     PRESENT simple (hikoya HAQIDA
     gapirilyapti, hikoya IChIDA emas)

  ⚠ 4-savol PRESENT zamonda - chunki
  hikoyani TAHLIL qilyapmiz.


⚠ 'INVOLVED':

  = ishtirok etgan, aloqador.
  ⚠ 'the people involved' = ishtirok
  etgan odamlar.
  ⚠ Sifat OTDAN KEYIN turibdi - bu
  'involved' kabi so'zlarda normal.

items.question: Where was Laura?
items.answer: She was on a train, in a compartment.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matndan: 'Laura was staring through the TRAIN
WINDOW' va 'entered her COMPARTMENT'.
⚠ 'ON a train' - predlog 'on'.

items.question: What was she doing?
items.answer: She was travelling home from Newcastle and staring through the train window.
items.whyUz:
⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - savol ham, javob ham.
⚠ Ikki ish bir vaqtda: 'travelling' va 'staring'.

items.question: When did the story take place?
items.answer: It took place on Christmas Eve.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to take place' = bo'lib o'tmoq.
⚠ 'ON Christmas Eve' - predlog 'on'.
⚠ 'take' - noto'g'ri fe'l: take → took.

items.question: Who are the people involved in the story?
items.whyUz:
⚠ Savol PRESENT zamonda - chunki hikoyani
TAHLIL qilyapmiz.
⚠ 'involved' = ishtirok etgan; OTDAN KEYIN
turadi.

items.question: What happened first?
items.answer: An elderly gentleman entered her compartment and gave her an envelope.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Suddenly an elderly gentleman ENTERED ...' -
birinchi voqea.
⚠ 'to happen' - to'g'ri fe'l: happened.

items.prompt: Oxirida Laura o'zini qanday his qildi?
items.question: How did Laura feel in the end?
items.answer: She felt sad. She thought sadly, "What shall I do?"
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matndan: 'she thought SADLY'.
⚠ 'to feel' - noto'g'ri fe'l: feel → felt.
⚠ 'in the end' = oxir-oqibat.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the prompts in the Photo File section and write a beginning and an ending for the story. Use the extracts in Ex. 20 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi rasmlar va ko'rsatmalarga qarang va hikoyaga boshlanish hamda tugash yozing. 20-mashqdagi parchalarni namuna qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaGA BOSh VA OXIR YoZISh.


BOShLANISh - TO'RT SAVOLGA JAVOB:

  1) WHEN - qachon
     'It was a cold winter evening ...'
     'It was Christmas Eve ...'

  2) WHERE - qayerda
     '... on a train.'
     '... in a small village.'

  3) WHO - kim
     'Laura was travelling home ...'

  4) WHAT HAPPENED FIRST - avval nima
     'Suddenly, an elderly gentleman
      entered her compartment.'

  ⚠ 'SUDDENLY' - hikoyada voqeani
  boshlashning eng qulay so'zi.


TUGASh - IKKI SAVOLGA JAVOB:

  1) WHAT HAPPENED IN THE END
     'In the end, she found out that
      ...'

  2) HOW THE PEOPLE FELT
     'She felt very happy / sad /
      relieved.'

  ⚠ His-tuyg'u sifatlari 28-betdagi
  15-mashqda: thrilled, anxious,
  nervous, sad, puzzled, amazed.


⚠ QAYSI ZAMONLAR:

  FON va TASVIR → PAST CONTINUOUS
     'It was raining ...'
     'She was wearing ...'

  VOQEALAR → PAST SIMPLE
     'He entered ...'
     'She opened ...'

  ⚠ Bu - 20-mashqdagi matnning
  AYNAN qolipi.


⚠ KETMA-KETLIK SO'ZLARI:

  Suddenly, ... - to'satdan
  Then, ... - keyin
  After that, ... - shundan keyin
  Finally, ... - nihoyat
  In the end, ... - oxir-oqibat


⚠ 'AN EXTRACT':

  = parcha (matndan).
  ⚠ 'to extract' = ajratib olmoq.

structure.modelEn: It was a cold, wet evening in November and Tom was walking home through the empty park.
structure.modelUz: Noyabrning sovuq, nam kechasi edi va Tom bo'sh bog' orqali uyiga piyoda ketayotgan edi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ Ob-havo va joy - hikoyaning FONI
(17-mashqning 'b' qo'llanishi).

structure.headingUz: Boshlanish: KIM va u nima qilayotgan edi
structure.modelEn: He was carrying a heavy bag and he was thinking about his exam the next day.
structure.modelUz: U og'ir sumka ko'targan va ertangi imtihoni haqida o'ylayotgan edi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ Ikki ish BIR VAQTDA → PAST CONTINUOUS
(17-mashqning 'a' qo'llanishi).

structure.modelEn: Suddenly, he heard a strange noise behind him. He turned round and saw a small dog running towards him.
structure.modelUz: To'satdan u orqasida g'alati shovqin eshitdi. U o'girildi va o'zi tomon yugurib kelayotgan kichkina itni ko'rdi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'SUDDENLY' + PAST SIMPLE - uzun ishni BO'LADI
(17-mashqning 'c' qo'llanishi).
⚠ 'saw a dog RUNNING' - -ING shakli jarayonni
bildiradi.

structure.modelEn: In the end, Tom took the dog home and found its owner the next morning.
structure.modelUz: Oxir-oqibat Tom itni uyiga olib ketdi va ertasi ertalab egasini topdi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'in the end' = oxir-oqibat.
⚠ Ketma-ket voqealar → PAST SIMPLE.

structure.headingUz: Tugash: ODAMLAR O'ZINI QANDAY HIS QILDI
structure.modelEn: The owner was thrilled to see his dog again, and Tom felt very happy. It was a day he would never forget.
structure.modelUz: Egasi itini yana ko'rganidan juda xursand bo'ldi, Tom esa o'zini juda baxtli his qildi. Bu u hech qachon unutmaydigan kun edi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ His-tuyg'u sifatlari 28-betdagi 15-mashqdan.
⚠ 'a day he would never forget' - unit nomiga
ishora: 'Days to Remember'.

patterns.exampleEn: At 6 am last Monday I was getting dressed.
patterns.exampleUz: O'tgan dushanba soat 6 da kiyinayotgan edim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ O'tmishning ANIQ paytida davom etayotgan ish
(17-mashqning 'd' qo'llanishi).

patterns.exampleEn: Paul wasn't hanging out the washing. He was painting the door.
patterns.exampleUz: Pol kir yoymayotgan edi. U eshikni bo'yayotgan edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ To'g'rilashning IKKI QADAMI: avval INKOR,
keyin TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

patterns.exampleEn: It was raining heavily. Suddenly, someone knocked on the door.
patterns.exampleUz: Qattiq yomg'ir yog'ardi. To'satdan kimdir eshikni taqillatdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ FON → past continuous; VOQEA → past simple.
⚠ 'Suddenly' - hikoyada voqeani boshlash so'zi.

patterns.formula: In the end, [nima bo'ldi]. He/She felt [his-tuyg'u].
patterns.exampleEn: In the end, he found the owner. He felt very happy.
patterns.exampleUz: Oxir-oqibat u egasini topdi. U o'zini juda baxtli his qildi.

groups.explanationUz: Past continuous va present continuous uchun bir xil.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ 'IN THE END' va 'AT THE END' - ADAShTIRMANG
groups.explanationUz: Ikkalasi ham qutida bor, lekin ma'nosi BOShQA.
